verses.mystical_translation: O the Living Presence my the Divine, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
Lest he tear my whole being like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
O the Living Presence my the Divine, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.

So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
The the Living Presence shall judge the people: judge me, O the Living Presence, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
Oh let the wickedness of the patterns rooted in harm come to an end; but establish the just: for the aligned with truth the Divine trieth the hearts and innermost being.
My defence is of the Divine, which saveth the upright in heart.
the Divine judgeth the aligned with truth, and the Divine is angry with the patterns rooted in harm every day.

Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
I will praise the the Living Presence according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the the Living Presence most high.

contemplative_note: Ask for justice while remaining willing to be examined by the same truth you invoke.
safety_note: Judgment imagery must not authorize vigilante violence; the psalmist also submits their own conduct to examination.
